text:
maya: OK quick design review — uploaded a new Figma for the quickstart banner + first-run checklist + sample projects carousel: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/quickstart-v3 :eyes:

alex: looked. Love the idea of in-banner checklist (reduces modal weight). Two quick copy things: 'Get started in 5 mins' vs 'Ready in 5 minutes' — prefer the latter for clarity. also suggest smaller CTA: 'Try sample app' not 'Launch sample project'.

samir: Accessibility nits: color contrast on the yellow 'Complete setup' badge is failing 3:1. Need to bump to darker yellow or use border. Also focus trap when checklist opens — keyboard users can't reach the 'skip for now' link currently.

rachel: On the carousel — can we surface per-sample runtimes + cost estimate? PMs keep asking for expected token cost. Maybe show an icon + 'approx 1.2¢/run' under each card.

maya: Good call on cost. Samir can you propose contrasts? Alex, can you try microcopy alternatives for CTAs & the progress label? I want 3 short options each.

alex: Will do. Quick question on anatomy: do we keep persistent left rail entry for 'Quickstart' after completion or hide it? UX vote?

samir: I'd hide it after completion but add a 'Revisit quickstart' link in Settings > Onboarding — fewer nav distractions. Also ensure the completion state is announced via aria-live so screen readers hear it.

maya: Agreed. Also debating whether checklist items should be required or advisory. My bias: keep advisory but mark completed ones with a subtle check + ability to undo. Ops concerns about metrics if optional though.

rachel: For metrics we can track 'engaged with checklist' vs 'completed items count' without forcing completion. That keeps UX friction low.

prod-bot: deploy status: no conflicts — branch quickstart/v3 ready for review (CI: ✅)

alex: Microcopy ideas (first pass): 1) CTA: 'Try sample app' 2) CTA alt: 'Open sample' 3) CTA alt2: 'Run example' — prefer #1. Progress label options: 'Setup progress', 'Quickstart progress', 'Getting started' — leaning 'Getting started'.

samir: Contrast proposals: A) #FFB900 on 1px #B36B00 border (passes 4.5:1) B) use #F3B84D on dark text (passes 3:1) — I prefer A for visual weight. Also added focus outline code snippet: 

```css
.quickstart-checklist:focus { outline: 3px solid #005fcc; outline-offset: 2px; }
```

maya: Nice. Can we also add a 1-line helper under the banner: 'Your project is private — learn about data handling' (link to privacy docs) — helps enterprise trust.

rachel: +1. Also ask design to ensure the link is keyboard-accessible and not lost in the banner truncation on small viewports.

maya: Next steps: Alex will push copy variants to Figma by EOD. Samir will propose final contrast + focus patterns. Rachel will mock the small cost badge and privacy link placement. I'll coordinate a quick 20-min sync tomorrow to pick winners and request a product review before dev handoff. Thanks all :rocket:

alex: noted, will tag PR with @prod-bot when ready.

samir: will run color checks with axe and send screenshots.

rachel: prepping sample app runtime estimates — should have numbers by EOD.

maya: Great — moving to implement.
